subject.title: fix(embeddings): honor request.allowPrivateNetwork for OpenAI-compatible embedding provider

question: Should a configured provider’s `request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` authorize private-network access when an internal caller replaces that provider’s configured base URL with `options.remote.baseUrl`?
rationale: The patch correctly uses the shared resolver, but the resolver treats this setting as a broad transport permission rather than exact-origin trust. Choosing whether a caller-selected endpoint inherits that grant defines the lasting SSRF authorization contract.

options.title: Approve provider-scoped authorization
options.body: Accept that an operator’s provider-level private-network opt-in authorizes compatible remote endpoint overrides, then merge with the existing override tests.

options.title: Bind authorization to remote endpoints
options.body: Require an explicit remote-level request-policy contract before a remote override can access private addresses.

options.title: Preserve strict remote overrides
options.body: Keep remote overrides private-network-blocked regardless of the configured provider setting, trading local-routing flexibility for a narrower boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-scoped authorization
recommendation.body: Accept that an operator’s provider-level private-network opt-in authorizes compatible remote endpoint overrides, then merge with the existing override tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is about the shared provider transport SSRF policy rather than the embedding adapter alone.
